description: Phase 6 - Real Master BOM generation: Create migration v1.2.1 with generate_master_bom RPC. Rewire publishStore.generateMasterBom to call the server-side RPC instead of client-side insert with string 'default' rule_set_id.
steps: Create migrations/v1.2.1_master_bom_generation.sql with: (a) CREATE FUNCTION perfecity.generate_master_bom(p_template_id UUID, p_user_id UUID) RETURNS UUID SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='perfecity' with body: auth check, DESIGNER/ADMIN role + ownership, template status=DRAFT check, resolve ACTIVE rule_set_id server-side (SELECT rule_set_id FROM rule_set WHERE status='ACTIVE'), compute baseline quantities at template base dimensions using the same rules as the BOM engine, INSERT master_bom (status='APPROVED', engine_version, rule_set_id, generated_at=now(), approved_by=p_user_id, approved_at=now()), INSERT master_bom_line for each zone/lighting/furniture/trim/mandatory-hidden-component (template_component_id, sku_id, product_type, source_zone_id, quantity_rule, default_quantity=1 as baseline, unit_of_measure, mandatory, hidden, calculation_parameters, parent_bom_line_id for DERIVED_FROM_PARENT), supersede previous APPROVED BOM (set status='INVALIDATED'). (b) Strengthen check_template_eligible: after existing checks, add a check that the APPROVED master_bom has >=1 master_bom_line AND covers every zone/lighting/furniture/trim/mandatory-hidden-component. (c) REVOKE ALL FROM anon, public; GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated. (d) INSERT audit_event (MASTER_BOM_GENERATED).

Update frontend/src/stores/publishStore.ts generateMasterBom action: Replace the client-side fromTable('master_bom').insert({...rule_set_id: 'default'...}) with a single supabase.rpc('generate_master_bom', { p_template_id: templateId, p_user_id: userId }) call. On success, fetch the generated BOM and lines to populate generatedBom/generatedBomLines state. Remove the hard-coded 'default' string.

Update frontend/src/stores/__tests__/publishStore.test.ts: Update mocks to reflect the RPC call instead of the direct insert. Test that the store correctly calls the RPC and handles success/error responses.
Add SQL test file tests/regression_v1.2.1.sql with structural assertions: generate_master_bom function exists with correct signature, check_template_eligible includes master_bom_line coverage check.
acceptance_criteria: generate_master_bom resolves rule_set_id server-side (no client-supplied UUID)
publishStore.generateMasterBom calls supabase.rpc instead of direct table insert
The string 'default' for rule_set_id no longer appears in publishStore.ts
check_template_eligible now requires master_bom_line coverage (not just header existence)
